values.Caption: Checklist Type
values.Description:
Checklist Type is meant to group all Questions of a same theme together.
Checklist are also attached to one Checklist Type.
By default, in a Checklist, it is only possible to select Question attached to the same Checklist Type than the Checklist.
This filter can be changed without any risks
